description: Add a `mohist/workspace-prepare` runner action that reconciles a workspace's local git state toward the expected branch at stage start, and inject it as the first task of every stage in the `mohist/local` and `mohist/github-pr` workflow profiles so that `rerun` after a failed stage (e.g. integrate rebase conflict) starts from a clean, aligned workspace.

tasks.title: Implement mohist/workspace-prepare runner action with diagnostics
tasks.description: Create `packages/runner/src/actions/workspace-prepare.ts` exporting `workspacePrepareAction: ActionHandler` plus a module-level `setWorkspacePrepareGitRunnerForTest` injectable seam (mirroring `rebase.ts`/`push.ts`). Register it as `mohist/workspace-prepare` in `createDefaultRegistry()` (`packages/runner/src/actions/registry.ts`). The action resolves workspace path + expected branch from `context.variables["workspace"]` (falling back to `context.workDir`), then executes the ordered pipeline: probe residual state via the injectable `git` wrapper → abort in-progress rebase/merge/cherry-pick (re-probing after each) → checkout expected branch if not on it → `git reset --hard HEAD` + `git clean -fd` → health-verify (HEAD on expected branch, clean tree, no rebase dirs). Fast-pass with no side effects when already clean. On any step failure emit the diagnostic output JSON (`kind: "workspace-prepare"`, `failureKind: "workspace-setup"`, failing `step`, `expectedBranch`, current `head`, `residual` probe, `porcelain`) per design D4/D6. Do NOT touch `WorkspaceManager.runHealthGate`/`reenterRunBranch`/`enforceCleanWorktree`. Add `workspace-prepare.spec.ts` using the fake-git runner harness (like `rebase.spec.ts`) covering fast-pass, each residual-state abort, checkout, reset+clean, health-verify gating, and failure diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/runner/src/actions/workspace-prepare.ts` exists and exports `workspacePrepareAction` plus `setWorkspacePrepareGitRunnerForTest` test seam.
`createDefaultRegistry()` in `packages/runner/src/actions/registry.ts` registers the handler under `mohist/workspace-prepare`.
Action fast-passes on an already-clean workspace (no git mutation commands issued) and completes in under one second — asserted by the fake-git harness recording zero mutating calls.
Action issues `git rebase --abort` when `.git/rebase-merge` or `.git/rebase-apply` is present, and performs no later step until no rebase remains in progress.
Action issues `git merge --abort` when `MERGE_HEAD` is present, and `git cherry-pick --abort` when `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD` is present (each re-probing afterward).
Action issues `git checkout <expected branch>` when HEAD is not on the expected branch and no residual operation is in progress.
Action issues `git reset --hard HEAD` followed by `git clean -fd` when the working tree/index is dirty, leaving the tree clean.
Action succeeds only when health-verify confirms HEAD on expected branch, clean working tree, and absence of both `.git/rebase-merge` and `.git/rebase-apply`.

On any failing git command or unmet health verification, the task fails and output JSON contains `kind: "workspace-prepare"`, `failureKind: "workspace-setup"`, the failing `step`, `expectedBranch`, current `head` (commit + ref or `(detached)`), the four-field `residual` probe, and `porcelain` (`git status --porcelain`).
Action performs no network operation (fetch/pull/push) and no workspace create/clone.

`packages/runner/tests/workspace-prepare.spec.ts` passes with fake-git scenarios for fast-pass, rebase/merge/cherry-pick abort, checkout, reset+clean, health-verify success, git-command failure, and unmet-health-verify failure.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and `npm test -w packages/runner` pass.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/workspace-prepare.ts (action + test seam), registry.ts registration, packages/runner/tests/workspace-prepare.spec.ts (fake-git scenarios). Runner typecheck + tests green.
tasks.notes: Follow design D1 (file layout + input resolution via resolvedWorkspaceToVariables), D2 (local residual-state probe via injectable git, do NOT import WorkspaceManager.detectResidualState), D3 (abort→checkout→reset+clean→verify ordering), D4 (reuse workspace-setup failureKind, no new DeliveryFailureKind), D6 (output JSON shape + task id `workspace-prepare`). Mirror rebase.ts:386-395 rev-parse probing and push.ts:17,27 input resolution.

tasks.title: Inject workspace-prepare as first task of every stage in mohist/local and mohist/github-pr profiles
tasks.description: Edit `packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/mohist-local.workflow.yaml` and `mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml` to prepend a `workspace-prepare` task (action `mohist/workspace-prepare`, title `Prepare workspace`) as the first entry of the `tasks:` array in all four stages (`plan`, `build`, `check`, `integrate`) of both files — 8 insertion points total, per design D5. Use an explicit first-task (no `init`/`preTasks` schema field) so the side effect stays profile-visible per the `pr-first-workflow` capability. Extend `packages/runner/tests/workflow-profile.spec.ts` (and any server-side profile parse test via `MohistWorkflow.cs`) to assert that `workspace-prepare` is the first task id of every stage in both profiles, that it appears exactly once per stage, and that it is not injected into `onFailure`/check-repair recovery sequences. Keep the existing `not.toContain("mohist/prepare")` assertion intact (design risk note: `mohist/workspace-prepare` does not contain that substring).
acceptanceCriteria: `mohist-local.workflow.yaml` declares a `workspace-prepare` task as the first entry of the `tasks:` list in each of the `plan`, `build`, `check`, and `integrate` stages.
`mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml` declares a `workspace-prepare` task as the first entry of the `tasks:` list in each of the `plan`, `build`, `check`, and `integrate` stages.
`workspace-prepare` appears exactly once per stage in each profile (not repeated between business tasks).
No `onFailure` or check-repair recovery task sequence in either profile is preceded by a fresh `workspace-prepare` task.
Profile YAML still parses successfully (server-side `MohistWorkflow.cs` parse test + runner-side `workflow-profile.spec.ts` disk-read parse pass).
`workflow-profile.spec.ts` asserts that the first task id of every stage in both profiles is `workspace-prepare`.
The existing `not.toContain("mohist/prepare")` assertion in `workflow-profile.spec.ts` still passes.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm test -w packages/runner`, and `npm test` (server) pass.
tasks.output: Edited mohist-local.workflow.yaml and mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml (workspace-prepare prepended to all 8 stage task lists), extended workflow-profile.spec.ts assertions. Runner + server typecheck/tests green.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 because the profiles reference the `mohist/workspace-prepare` action which must be registered before dispatch can succeed. Per design D5 the injection is an explicit first task (honors pr-first-workflow's no-hidden-stage-boundary-side-effect rule), NOT a profile-level init/preTasks mechanism. The structural property 'runs once at stage start, never before recovery tasks' is guaranteed by executor task-list iteration + recovery injection happening only after a business task fails.
